interface.title: Structure Alignment Suite (pdb_align Streamlit app)
interface.field: Structural biology / protein structure prediction assessment
interface.stage_of_work: Analysis and validation: comparing a predicted or alternative model against a reference structure
interface.what_it_is_for: Superimpose one or more mobile protein structures onto a reference and report RMSD, TM-score, GDT_TS, lDDT-Cα and coverage, with a plain-language quality verdict, flagged deviating regions and (when the code works) 3D, per-residue, ensemble, model-evaluation and export views.

data.note: Uploaded ref.pdb and mob.pdb (the quickstart pair, chain A only), then 1crn.pdb and 1ubq.pdb (unrelated folds) through the sidebar's multi-file uploader. Every test structure has only chain A, so a two-sided interface could not be defined for DockQ. The pdb:/af: fetch box needs network access the server does not have.

features.name: Quality verdict header with metric cards
features.general: Condense a comparison into a coloured pass/fail verdict sentence, a row of key scores with help tooltips, a confidence label, and warnings when the evidence is thin
features.specific: Coloured GOOD/POOR headline ('Same fold: 100% of residues superimpose within 0.7 A, TM=0.88'), cards for RMSD, TM-score, GDT_TS, lDDT-Cα and Coverage, a 'Confidence: high/low' caption, and yellow warnings for low coverage or fewer than ~30 matched residues. Quirk: the tooltip shown beside GDT_TS's ? reads like another metric's definition. With several mobiles the header shows the best model's numbers but does not name it
steps: Load reference and model
Press Run
Read the verdict colour and sentence
Hover a metric's ? for its definition
Note the confidence and any coverage warnings
serves_tasks: Get a summary verdict and core similarity scores for a good model
Check a poor match and see which regions deviate
Repeat the comparison with a different method and compare the outcomes
Repeat the comparison using a different set of atoms and compare the scores

features.name: Automatic method selection with explanation and flagged-regions table
features.general: Try several matching methods, keep the best one, explain why it was picked, and list the stretches that deviate most
features.specific: Overview tab: 'Method: Sequence-free (window) · Strategy: single', a line comparing coverage-weighted scores of the competing methods (e.g. 6.8: 46 pairs @ 7.18 Å vs Sequence-guided 3.1: 21 pairs), or 'Manual mode.' when a mode is forced, plus a Flagged regions table (chain, start, end, n_residues, max_rmsd, mean_rmsd, kind) or 'No flagged high-deviation regions.' The first render after Run can read 'No flagged high-deviation regions.' and show the table only after the app reruns
steps: Leave Mode on auto or force a mode
Press Run
Read which method won and why
Scan the flagged-regions table for deviating segments
serves_tasks: Check a poor match and see which regions deviate
Repeat the comparison with a different method and compare the outcomes

features.specific: Multi-file 'Upload PDB/mmCIF' box (with + Add files), a Reference single-select, a Mobile(s) multiselect with Select all that leaves out the current reference, and a Reference chains multiselect filled from the chosen reference
steps: Upload several PDB/mmCIF files
Choose the Reference
Choose one or more Mobile(s) (or Select all)
Restrict reference chains if needed
Press Run
serves_tasks: Load the structure files to compare

features.name: Alignment method and scope picker
features.general: Pick a matching algorithm (by sequence, by shape, or flexible) and whether to match the whole structure or a local part, then re-run to compare
features.specific: Mode (auto/seq_guided/seq_free_shape/seq_free_window/flexible) and Strategy (auto/global/local) dropdowns; a forced mode is reported as 'Manual mode.' in the Overview

Press Run and compare the verdict with the auto run

steps: Expand Advanced

Press Run and compare the scores
